LLM Political Ideology Audit

How do large language models (LLMs) handle politically sensitive and contested topics? Responses are scored across relevance & accuracy, plurality & breadth, and Wikipedia was used as the ground truth for accurate, balanced responses. You can find more documentation here: https://github.com/zpsheldon/llm-ideology-audit
